about: Factory track presets for audio tracks. They pair the built-in starter amp
with EQ, compressor and reverb so a guitar or bass plugged straight into
the interface sounds usable in one click. They omit gain and pan, so the
track keeps its volume, and they are not meant to replace VST3 amp sims.
Every starter's settings start from `base`, then its own values apply.

starters.name: Clean guitar
starters.hint: Warm and round, with a little room

starters.name: Crunch guitar
starters.hint: Rock rhythm that cleans up when you play softly

starters.name: Lead guitar
starters.hint: Thick, singing distortion for riffs and solos

starters.name: Bass
starters.hint: Solid low end with a little grit on top
